input.command:
node -e '
const fs=require("fs");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json"));
p.scripts={check:p.scripts.check,lint:"oxlint","lint:fix":"oxlint --fix",format:"oxfmt","format:check":"oxfmt --check"};
fs.writeFileSync("package.json",JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+"\n")'
cat >> AGENTS.md <<'EOF'

## Linting and formatting

This project uses [oxlint](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter) for linting and [oxfmt](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter) for formatting. Config lives in `.oxlintrc.json` and `.oxfmtrc.json`.

- Run `bun run format` and `bun run lint` after making code changes.
- Before finishing a task, `bun run format:check`, `bun run lint` and `bun run check` must all pass.
- Fix lint errors at the source; do not disable rules or add ignore comments unless there is a documented reason.
- Do not hand-format code or add other formatters/linters (Prettier, ESLint, Biome).
EOF

content.text:
I installed `oxfmt` and `oxlint` as dev dependencies and set them up with default rules. `bun run format:check` passes and `bun run lint` runs clean. I didn't re-run `bun run check` (tsc) after formatting.

- **Config:** `bun` generated `.oxfmtrc.json` and `.oxlintrc.json` with their defaults. The lint config only turns on the `correctness` category as errors.
- **Scripts:** I added `lint` (`oxlint`), `lint:fix` (`oxlint --fix`), `format` (`oxfmt`) and `format:check` (`oxfmt --check`) to `package.json`. The existing `check` script is unchanged.
- **AGENTS.md:** I added a "Linting and formatting" section. It says to run `format` and `lint` after code changes and to make `format:check`, `lint` and `check` pass before finishing. It also says to fix lint errors rather than disable rules, and not to add other formatters or linters.
- **Reformatting:** Running `oxfmt` also touched `README.md` (one line added) and `tsconfig.json` (one line changed). Nothing is committed, so you can review or revert those with `git diff`.
